messages:
jin: Heads-up — noticed an increase in p50 for seqlen 128 requests on canary yesterday after the pick-autotune change. p50 jumped ~18ms.
max: Which canary? https://canary/dashboard/2417 :eyes:
jin: canary=ded-asia-pool-3, run id=ci/2417. Logs show `kv_cache_hit=false` and the runtime falling back to `matmul_generic` instead of `matmul_unroll_v3` on arm64.
sara: do we have detailed pick logs? I thought we enabled some debug flags last week.
jin: We set `RW_PICK_INSPECT=1` but it only emits the chosen kernel name. I pulled a sample from the node and found an internal candidate vector — looks like we compute scores but don't ship them. snippet:

```
trace_id=ci-2417-9
req_id=2417-req-42
arch=arm64
seqlen=128
kv_cache_hit=false
chosen=matmul_generic
reason=latency_safety_threshold
candidates=[matmul_unroll_v3:0.48, matmul_generic:0.52, matmul_tiled:0.32]
```

max: interesting — so the scoring is happening. Can we flip a flag to dump the candidate list? `KERNEL_PICK_VERBOSE=1`? :zap:
perf-bot: PROFILE-SUMMARY ci/2417-9: p50=112ms (+18ms vs baseline), p95=290ms (+40ms), cpu_cycles +12% (sampled on node gpu-3).
sara: @max @devops-ci can we add an opt-in structured single-line log with candidate scores + pick context? we'll need seqlen_bucket + kv cache state + batch_id for correlation.
max: i'll prototype `RW_PICK_STRUCT_LOG=1` — emits a single-line JSON blob with fields: trace_id, req_id, arch, seqlen_bucket, kv_hit, candidate_scores, final_choice, reason_flags, env_flags. keep it sampled.
jin: also include `routing_policy` and `batch_key` — I saw different choices when requests were forced into batch_id 7.
devops-ci: rolled a patch to ded-asia-pool-3 with `RW_PICK_STRUCT_LOG=1` for the next rollout. deploy ref: deploy/2417771234-pick-emit.
sara: for cost control sample 1% of requests for full vectors and compress them with base64+zlib. also add a small metric `pick_confidence` = top_score - runner_up_score. that should surface unstable picks.
max: agreed. also add `pick_candidate_count` and `pick_top_delta` to metrics.
jin: temporary mitigation: add sticky override to prefer `matmul_unroll_v3` when seqlen in [96,160] && arch=arm64 && kv_cache_hit=false. can someone own rollback if we see regressions?
sara: @max you own canary rollback. @jin run a 12h A/B and drop logs into /tmp/pick-audit. :thumbsup:
jin: will run A/B and attach samples. quick example of desired structured log format (single-line):

```
{"trace_id":"ci-2417-9","req_id":"2417-req-42","arch":"arm64","seqlen":128,"seqlen_bucket":"96-160","kv_hit":false,"batch_id":7,"candidate_scores":[{"name":"matmul_unroll_v3","score":0.48},{"name":"matmul_generic","score":0.52},{"name":"matmul_tiled","score":0.32}],"final_choice":"matmul_generic","reason_flags":["latency_safety_threshold"],"env_flags":["RW_PICK_INSPECT","RW_PICK_STRUCT_LOG"]}
```

max: please keep the candidate vector compressed when large. store full vectors in S3 via async uploader. add correlation id for tracing across systems.
perf-bot: NOTE: set `RW_PICK_SAMPLE_RATE=0.01` to match the 1% sampling proposal.
sara: post-mortem asks: surface a daily alert when `pick_confidence` median < 0.05 for any seqlen bucket — indicates indecisive scoring.
max: +1. i'll add the alert and a dashboard pane for seqlen vs pick_confidence.
jin: side-note: kv-cache probing showed intermittent `miss` spikes at 03:12 UTC which correlated with a config sync on node kube-9. suspect transient eviction race.
devops-ci: opened infra ticket INFRA-2417 for kube-9 config race and increased kv-cache TTL on that node to 60s as an experiment.
sara: thanks. sync tomorrow 10:00 to review structured logs and decide if candidate vectors become permanent.
jin: will upload A/B results and samples. :eyes:
max: thanks all.
perf-bot: end of thread — sampling config applied.
